correctness.rationale: Two even-part colors give the logarithmic marking multiplier 4L(q²). The eta transformation contributes w/(√2π), C=π²/4, and the exponent shift −w/8; the anomalous E₂ term gives −1/w in the marking multiplier. The first Lambert layer of log A already supplies the angular deficit min(M³θ²,M) for M=floor(1/t): Taylor bounds for small M|θ|, a uniform positive Riemann-sum bound for the intermediate compact range, and the geometric sum bound for large M|θ|. Positivity bounds the marked factor by O(t⁻²). On the short arc, the modular remainders are exponentially small. To justify the contour replacement explicitly, at height ±y₀ with y₀=t^(3/2−δ), join the vertical segment at Re w=t to the circle |w|=t by a horizontal segment; Re(C/w+Nw)=2Nt−Ny₀²/t+O(Ny₀⁴/t³) uniformly on each connector. On the complementary circle arc the phase is 2Nt cos(arg w), giving at least the same order of loss. Because Nt=C/t, these errors are negligible to every algebraic order. The Laurent coefficient integrals give exactly I₀, I₁, I₂ in the model. Using I₀−I₂=2I₁/z, the ratio simplifies to 2N/3−(1/3)√(N/C) I₁(z)/I₂(z)+1/6 up to superpolynomial error. The two leading terms of I₁/I₂ are 1+3/(2z), giving the additional constant −1/(4C). Replacing N=n−1/8 gives 1/12−1/π² and the stated O(n⁻¹ᐟ²) remainder. The odd-mass statement follows by exact conservation of total mass.
residual_risks: No effective error constant or explicit sign cutoff is proved; finite diagnostics are not used as the asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: The term of order √n settles the sign of the mean parity imbalance that the color-density heuristic leaves undecided. The constant and quantitative remainder sharpen this beyond leading-order asymptotics, for the exact statistic singled out by the congruence literature. Establishing the marked asymptotic requires resolving a genuine lower-order contribution, not recomputing the unweighted count or estimating a finite sample.
residual_risks: No distributional theorem, general colored-partition extension or effective finite-n cutoff is established.
